notes: §2002:14.8.47.2 SR3 "If the organization of the write file is indexed or relative, format 2 shall be specified": pb5579_write_file_indexed_relative_2002 (accept [2002]) writes Format 2 WRITE FILE on an indexed and a relative file; g2_write_file_advancing_indexed_neg (WRITE FILE IX FROM WX AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE on an indexed file) is refused at --std 2002 with COBOL1720 at the WRITE (golden-2002-3 integrator, main 63ab0c4ece; the writers had deferred the row because their pinned build predated PB5579).
